issue.title: [Bug] lsp_format_document rewrites non-UTF-8 bytes as U+FFFD, and read_file labels such files UTF-8 (follow-up to #1854)

steps: Use the shell and Python pathlib.Path to create legacy.legacy with write_bytes(b'caf\xe9\nold\n'). Create its parent directory if needed. Call read_file with path="legacy.legacy" and metadata_only=true. Show the raw Encoding line.
expected: Metadata does not label a byte sequence invalid as UTF-8 as UTF-8.
defect: read_file metadata reports Encoding: UTF-8 because Node lossy decoding does not throw on invalid bytes.

fault location.explanation: The metadata branch initializes encoding to UTF-8 and changes it only when readFile(path,"utf-8") throws. Node substitutes invalid bytes instead, so the error-based detector is unsound. The separate LSP formatter damage also reported here is not reachable through this ACP unit and is not part of this case.

Root cause: The metadata branch initializes encoding to UTF-8 and changes it only when readFile(path,"utf-8") throws. Node substitutes invalid bytes instead, so the error-based detector is unsound.
